title: Validate a path value
summary: Fastify: Validate a path value. Visit /books/cat and read the validation error.
introduction: A schema describes allowed data. GET /books/3 converts and checks id as a positive integer.
learningObjectives: Validate a path value with Fastify
Visit /books/cat and read the validation error

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install fastify@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000 and stop each server before the next example.

blocks.title: Validate a path value

blocks.text: The integer schema converts and checks the path input. The handler receives numeric id 3.
Visit /books/cat and read the validation error.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Schemas must describe the input shape you actually expect.
